summary: Flex Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled Nasdaq-listed manufacturer, reported via 8-K that on October 9, 2026, it entered a $1.1 billion senior bridge term loan credit facility with Citibank as administrative agent, funding it in a single advance on October 14, 2026, in connection with consummating the Transaction. The filing does not name the target, purchase price, or consideration mix; item 2.01 signals a completed acquisition or disposition of assets. The bridge matures October 13, 2027 and floats at Term SOFR or Base Rate plus a ratings-based margin, with a 4.50x Debt/EBITDA and 3.00x interest coverage covenant. Watch for deal terms and target identity in exhibits.
